plain_english: Nothing blocks folk, nothing blocks devotees from Your veiling.
sanskrit_cite: na kiñcid eva lokānāṃ bhavadāvaraṇaṃ prati \var{yat kiṃ cid eva bhūtānāṃ\em \cit \Naresvaraparīksā} na kiñcid eva bhaktānāṃ bhavadāvaraṇaṃ prati

plain_english: Though reached by method-ladders, crowded with attributes — to devotees the self appears at once, pure.
sanskrit_cite: apy upāyakramaprāpyaḥ saṅkulo 'pi viśeṣaṇaiḥ bhaktibhājāṃ bhavān ātmā sakṛc chuddho 'vabhāsate

plain_english: Laughing victors, laughing conquered — drunk on His devotion-nectar, whoever they are, Lord.
sanskrit_cite: jayanto 'pi hasanty ete jitā api hasanti ca bhavadbhaktisudhāpānamattāḥ ke 'py eva ye prabho

plain_english: May I never dry up, never seek release — full of His devotion-rasa, best-liked, attained.
sanskrit_cite: śuṣkakaṃ maiva siddheya maiva mucyeya vāpi tu svādiṣṭhaparakāṣṭāptatvadbhaktirasanirbharaḥ

plain_english: As unknown before was this devotion-rasa of Yours to me — so, Lord, may that same one grow.
sanskrit_cite: yathaivajñātapūrvo 'yaṃ bhavadbhaktiraso mama ghaṭitas tadvad īśāna sa eva paripuṣyatu

plain_english: Truly, Lord, I have no other prayer-course — only may such immersion-possession by devotion be mine always.
sanskrit_cite: satyena bhagavan nānyaḥ prārthanāprasaro 'sti me kevalaṃ sa tathā ko 'pi bhaktyāveśo 'stu me sadā

plain_english: Drunk on devotion I may rage, repent, leap, shout "Śiva" — enough.
sanskrit_cite: bhaktikṣīvo 'pi kupyeyaṃ bhavāyānuśayīya ca tathā haseyaṃ udyāṃ ca raṭeyaṃ ca śivety alam

plain_english: In crisis or at peace, weeping or laughing, deep or distracted — may I be, Lord, by devotion.
sanskrit_cite: viṣamastho 'pi svastho 'pi rudann api hasann api gambhīro 'pi vicitto 'pi bhaveyaṃ bhaktitaḥ prabho

plain_english: For devotees nothing to be known, inside You or out — where consciousness-natured You stand thought-free.
sanskrit_cite: bhaktānāṃ nāsti saṃvedyaṃ tvadantar yadi vā bahiḥ ciddharmā yatra na bhavān nirvikalpaḥ sthitaḥ svayam

plain_english: Devotees rejoice even at abusers — pierced within, bristling with sharp horripilation, as if by nectar-drops.
sanskrit_cite: bhaktā nindānukare 'pi tavāmṛtakaṇair iva hṛṣyanty evāntarāviddhās tīkṣṇaromāñcasūcibhiḥ

plain_english: Even pain-feeling ripens to enjoyment for devotees, whose all-awareness, moon-wet, is moonlight-made.
sanskrit_cite: duḥkhāpi vedanā bhaktimatāṃ bhogāya kalpate yeṣāṃ sudhārdrā sarvaiva saṃvit tvaccandrikāmayī

plain_english: Wherever held, devotees — inside and out — unfeigned, Your body-touch-taste-joy the same.
sanskrit_cite: yatra tatroparuddhānāṃ bhaktānāṃ bahirantare nirvyājaṃ tvadvapuḥsparśarasāsvādasukhaṃ samam

plain_english: In worship of Your devotion, duality's double-refuge meanness — tasting the clear nectar-body, some dissolve it.
sanskrit_cite: taveśa bhakter arcāyāṃ dainyāṃśaṃ dvayasaṃśrayam vilupyāsvādayanty eke vapur acchaṃ sudhāmayam

plain_english: Erring are pilgrim-eyes, divided — for division is just erring; but matchless, strifeless Being shines for devotees.
sanskrit_cite: bhrāntās tīrthadṛśo bhinnā bhrānter eva hi bhinnatā niṣpratidvandvi vastv ekaṃ bhaktānāṃ tvaṃ tu rājase

plain_english: Mind ripened past honor, contempt, love and the rest into stainlessness — how could its bearer be world-mannered?
sanskrit_cite: mānāvamānarāgādiniṣpākavimalaṃ manaḥ yasyāsau bhaktimāṃl lokatulyaśīlaḥ kathaṃ bhavet

plain_english: Passion-aversion-darkness conquered by devotion-light — who are the knowledge-rich before them?
sanskrit_cite: rāgadveṣandhakāro 'pi yeṣāṃ bhaktitviṣā jitaḥ teṣāṃ mahīyasām agre katame jñānaśālinaḥ

plain_english: Whose rite is devotion-nectar-drink-and-bath — high joy from beginning through end.
sanskrit_cite: yasya bhaktisudhāsnānapānādividhisādhanam tasya prārabdhamadhyāntadaśāsūccaiḥ sukhāsikā

plain_english: Praised, sought, worshipped — for that alone devotees' world-life is praiseworthy.
sanskrit_cite: kīrtyaś cintāpadaṃ mṛgyaḥ pūjyo yena tvam eva tat bhavadbhaktimatāṃ ślāghyā lokayātrā bhavanmayī

plain_english: Liberation's name is but Your ripe devotion — mounted on its first stage, we are near-free.
sanskrit_cite: muktisaṃjñā vipakvāyā bhakter eva tvayi prabho tasyām ādyadaśārūḍhā muktakalpā vayaṃ tataḥ

plain_english: May pain's coming be great for me, devotion-filled self — never turned from You, be even pleasure-line.
sanskrit_cite: duḥkhāgamo 'pi bhūyān me tvadbhaktibharitātmanaḥ tvatparācī vibho mā bhūd api saukhyaparamparā

plain_english: You are pleased by devotion; devotion, You pleased — this mutual dependence is fitting, as You alone know.
sanskrit_cite: tvaṃ bhaktyā prīyase bhaktiḥ prīte tvayi ca nātha yat tadanyonyāśrayaṃ yuktaṃ yathā vettha tvam eva tat

plain_english: With form or formless, inside or out — to devotion-selves, always nectar, Lord.
sanskrit_cite: sākāro vā nirākaro vāntar vā bahir eva vā bhaktimattātmanāṃ nātha sarvathāsi sudhāmayaḥ

plain_english: In this very world, for Your devotees, another world-stand exists — fruit of joy-showing.
sanskrit_cite: asminn eva jagaty antar bhavadbhaktimataḥ prati harṣaprakāśanaphalam anyad eva jagatsthitam

plain_english: Devotion hidden, devotion supreme, devotion to the world-great Lord — devotion, ah, something in You, Śiva.
sanskrit_cite: guhye bhaktiḥ pare bhaktir bhaktir viśvamaheśvare tvayi śambhau śive deva bhaktir nāma kim apy aho

plain_english: Devotion, devotion, supreme devotion — I cry loud: let fierce devotion be mine supreme.
sanskrit_cite: bhaktir bhaktiḥ pare bhaktir bhaktir nāma samutkaṭā tāraṃ viraumi yat tīvrā bhaktir me 'stu paraṃ tvayi

plain_english: Since I am the birth-ground of all beauties — stuck to You, jewel or straw becomes priceless.
sanskrit_cite: yato 'smi sarvaśobhānāṃ prasavāvanir īśa tat tvayi lagnam anarghaṃ syād ratnam vā yadi vā tṛṇam

plain_english: From knower and from knowable, on whose knowing-road there is no parting from You — they win, Your devotees, ever fearless.
sanskrit_cite: āvedakād ā ca vedyād yeṣāṃ saṃvedanādhvani bhavatā na viyogo 'sti te jayanti bhavajjuṣaḥ

plain_english: Embraced in saṃsāra's hall by some, You — Lord, by others self-tormenting unreined.
sanskrit_cite: saṃsārasadaso bāhye kaiś cittvaṃ parirabhyase svāmin parais tu tatraiva tāmyadbhis tyaktayantraṇaiḥ

plain_english: With Śivā who eats, decks, celebrates the world, festival-hurried — hug tight, Śiva, I bow.
sanskrit_cite: pānāśanaprasādhanasambhuktasamastaviśvayā śivayā pralayotsavasarabhasayā dṛḍham upagūḍhaṃ śivaṃ vande

plain_english: Peerless overlordship wins, world-Lord, being subject-free — and so does Your otherness, by which this world shines as it does not.
sanskrit_cite: parameśvaratā jayaty apūrvā tava viśveśa yadīśitavyaśūnyā aparāpi tathaiva te yayedaṃ jagad ābhāti yathā tathā na bhāti
